title: Nested-GAN
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: Epoch context
description: Single EEG channel with neighbouring epochs.

nodes.title: Inner spectrogram model
description: Centre-epoch STFT; real/imaginary channels into a flat Restormer stack.
Channel attention (MDTA) and gated feed-forward blocks; inverse STFT.

nodes.title: Modify centre only
description: Subtract inner artifact from the centre of a copied context.

nodes.title: Outer temporal U-Net
description: Transpose-convolution decoder concatenates matching encoder skips.

nodes.title: Add residual artifact
description: Sum inner artifact and outer residual prediction.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.
